system.description: You spend a Willpower Trait and Mental Traits to fill the area with thick fog, impairing vision so that characters must bid two extra Traits to spot anything by sight (unless they have Basic Auspex or better) and halving the effective range of ranged weapons. At this level you may also summon gentle wind, adjust ambient temperature by about 10 degrees Fahrenheit, and produce similarly mild weather effects; faster changes cost more Mental Traits and very rapid, dramatic shifts risk a Masquerade breach. This power generally does not function well indoors, though the Storyteller has final say on specific effects.
system.duration: Minutes to a day depending on Traits spent
